scope: Backup confirmation and recovery write-failure handling;not whole interface/security audit

browser.scope: Actual UI file chooser/download exports,two synthetic localhost tabs. Storage write failures are simulated separately by unit tests,not browser quota exhaustion.

rules: UI confirmation compares exact current raw workspace with the workspace observed when the file was selected. Changed/deleted/new/corrupt raw data rejects before writing either key.
Successful local save,reload and cancel clear pending import and invalidate asynchronous file reads.
Normal explicit restore retains previous raw workspace,including corrupted data,for recovery.
If workspace write fails after recovery write,older recovery is restored or removed to preserve its prior absence. Failed recovery write aborts before replacing workspace.
limits: localStorage has no multi-key transaction or cross-tab compare-and-swap lock. This is a synchronous pre-write stale-state check,not atomic cross-tab serialization.

If storage also blocks compensating rollback,an explicit error reports inability to restore older recovery. Live workspace remains unchanged in the simulated failure;older recovery is not guaranteed. Export copies before restore.
The optional expectedRaw argument remains optional for internal callers;all UI confirmation paths pass it. No protected roles/cloud storage.
Previous snapshots,approval/version logic and grading unchanged. No learner outcome claim.
